decision.explanation: The provided documents contain conflicting claims regarding the educational institutions attended by 'Tori Z Forbes'. Document 1 (D1) asserts attendance at the University of Notre Dame (D1S4, D1S6). Document 2 (D2) asserts undergraduate attendance at the East China University of Science and Technology (D2S5) and graduate attendance at the University of California, Berkeley (D2S30). Per the instruction to preserve distinct valid referents and complementary answers where competing assertions exist without resolving them as errors, all three institutions are included as they are explicitly supported by the source text as educational affiliations for the named entity.
